info.title: Ranked AI REST API
info.description: Public REST API for Ranked AI — an SEO and AI visibility platform. Manage projects, track keyword rankings, monitor AI prompt visibility, run site audits, analyze backlinks, manage content calendars, generate reports, and configure webhooks.

tags.name: AI Visibility
tags.description: Monitor AI prompt visibility and citations

tags.name: Audits
tags.description: Run and review SEO site audits

tags.name: Backlinks
tags.description: Analyze backlink profiles and referring domains

tags.name: Webhooks
tags.description: Configure webhook subscriptions for event notifications

get.description: Returns all projects owned by the API key holder.
Returns tracked keywords with position data for a project.
Returns historical position data for a specific keyword. Defaults to the last 90 days if no date range is specified.
Returns AI prompts with visibility and response data for a project.
Returns detailed data for a specific AI prompt including per-model responses.
Returns response history from each AI model for a specific prompt. Defaults to the last 90 days.
Returns a list of SEO audit tasks for a project.
Returns the most recent completed audit for a project, including issue summary with dismissed (passed) vs active (failed) counts.
Returns issues for a specific audit. Issues are sorted by severity (critical > warning > notice) then by affected count descending. Dismissed issues are returned with status `passed`.
Returns tracked backlinks overview for a project with summary metrics from the latest backlink check.
Returns aggregated backlink metrics for the entire project across all tracked domains.
Returns referring domains for the project's tracked backlinks with pagination and sorting.
Returns historical backlink data for the project. Defaults to the last 90 days if no date range is specified.
Returns anchor text distribution for the project's backlinks, sorted by count descending.
Returns content calendar items for a project. Without date filters, returns items scheduled up to 7 days in the future.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter content by status name (e.g. Draft, Published).

get.description: Returns details for a specific content item including the content body and metadata.
Returns content and publishing preferences for a project.

patch.description: Updates content and publishing preferences for a project. Requires `write:all` scope.

get.description: Returns generated report links for a project.

post.description: Triggers report generation and returns a shareable link. Report links default to the agencyreport.ai domain. Requires `write:all` scope.

get.description: Returns details for a specific report including its configuration.

parameters.name: reportId
parameters.description: The short report ID (nanoid), not the database UUID.

delete.description: Soft-deletes a report link. Requires `write:all` scope.

parameters.name: reportId
parameters.description: The short report ID (nanoid), not the database UUID.

get.description: Returns webhook subscriptions for the authenticated user. Optionally filter by project.

post.description: Creates a new webhook subscription. The webhook `secret` is only returned on creation — store it securely. Requires `write:all` scope. The URL must use HTTPS and must not point to private or internal addresses.

get.description: Returns details for a specific webhook subscription.

patch.description: Updates a webhook subscription. Re-enabling a webhook resets its consecutive failure count. Requires `write:all` scope.

delete.description: Permanently deletes a webhook subscription and its delivery logs. Requires `write:all` scope.

post.description: Sends a test webhook payload to verify the endpoint is reachable and responding. The webhook must be active. Requires `write:all` scope.

bearerAuth.description: API key passed as a Bearer token in the Authorization header.

LimitParam.name: limit
LimitParam.description: Maximum number of items to return.

OffsetParam.name: offset
OffsetParam.description: Number of items to skip for pagination.

DateFromParam.name: date_from
DateFromParam.description: Start of date range filter (ISO 8601 format, YYYY-MM-DD).

DateToParam.name: date_to
DateToParam.description: End of date range filter (ISO 8601 format, YYYY-MM-DD).

Unauthorized.description: Authentication failed — missing or invalid API key.

Forbidden.description: Insufficient permissions or project not accessible.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the rate limit resets.

X-RateLimit-Reset.description: Unix timestamp when the rate limit resets.

reset.description: Unix timestamp when the rate limit resets.

limit.description: Page size used for this request.

has_more.description: Whether more items exist beyond the current page.

net_change.description: Sum of position changes across all device types in the date range. Positive = improved.

UpdateContentPreferencesRequest.description: At least one of `preferences` or `publishing_preferences` must be provided.

WebhookWithSecret.description: Webhook response returned only on creation, includes the signing secret.

secret.description: HMAC signing secret. Only returned on creation — store it securely.

url.description: Must use HTTPS. Cannot point to private or internal addresses.

status_code.description: HTTP status code returned by the webhook endpoint.
